summary: Picks up files from an S3-compatible bucket on a schedule.

properties.name: BucketName
properties.description: Name of the bucket to read files from.

properties.name: FolderName
properties.description: Folder (object key prefix) within the bucket to read files from.

properties.name: BatchSize
properties.description: Maximum number of files to fetch per polling batch.

properties.name: ResponseEncoding
properties.description: Encoding used to decode file contents (e.g. utf8).

properties.name: DeleteMovesFileTo
properties.description: Folder to move a file to after it's received. If empty, the file is deleted instead.
